title: Week 2 Everyday Needs
objectives: Ask for repetition and clarification politely.
Use basic needs language for errands and simple requests.
Handle a short grocery or corner-store exchange.

activities.title: Clarification Practice
activities.instructions: Practice asking someone to repeat more slowly, then restate the idea in your own words.

activities.title: Needs and Requests
activities.instructions: Review high-value phrases for help, prices, and quantities.

activities.title: Corner Store Run
activities.instructions: Ask for two everyday items, confirm the price, and thank the clerk.
